name: British Raj (civil ensign)
description: A British red ensign defaced with the Star of India: the Order's star within a garter inscribed 'Heaven's Light Our Guide', ensigned by a crown.
history: The red ensign borne by British India from the 1860s until 1947 — the closest thing the Raj had to a national flag, flown at international gatherings from the Olympics to the League of Nations.

features.role: Star of India badge under a Tudor crown
